integrity_statement: The general theorem is proved by exact edge Green-kernel identities. The executable finite tests are corroboration only. No external validation or publication priority is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite undirected positively weighted trees with at least two vertices, one perfectly grounded leader, and inverse-square trace; no claim for cycles, multiple leaders, or finite-strength pinning. Scalar arithmetic complexity does not guarantee floating-point tie resolution.
title: Strict geodesic unimodality of single-grounding second-order coherence on weighted trees
